# Visualizer provenance

See [OPEN_SOURCE_NOTICES.md](../../OPEN_SOURCE_NOTICES.md) for exact research revisions, licenses and interaction references.

All files under `src/visualizer/` are original application code implementing standard algorithms. **Design reference only — no source copied.** No upstream parser files, images or trained weights are vendored. The model viewer reads a bounded Keras JSON configuration with an original Zod schema; it does not claim Netron's format coverage.

The existing Diagram Design provenance remains in `diagram-design/UPSTREAM.md`.
